newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HCL copper prices for March 1997.
newsitem.headline: India's HCL copper prices for March 1997.

text.p: Following are copper product prices for March, 1997, announced by the state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd, and circulated by the Bombay Metal Exchange Ltd.
The data is the latest available.

The above prices are exclusive of excise duty, octroi, C.S.T./ sales tax etc. which will be charged extra as applicable. The prices of Item No. 1, & 2 are for deliveries ex-our godown at Central Warehousing Corporation, Cotton Green, Bombay and for Item No. 3 & 4 ex-our Taloja works. However,for C.C. rods sales ex: godowns the prices shall be as under:-
Ex-Bombay godown Rs 1,27,350 PMT Rs 1,26,350 PMT
Ex-Goa godown Rs 1,28,000 PMT Rs 1,27,000 PMT
Ex-Indore godown Rs 1,27,600 PMT Rs 1,26,600 PMT
Ex-Silvasa godown Rs 1,27,820 PMT Rs 1,26,820 PMT

The excise duty applicable for the above ex:godown prices for C.C. rods will be the amount paid by our plant at Taloja. Sales tax, octroi and other statutory levies will be charged extra as applicable.
